'''Kavanix Unbeatable Light Space''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Kavanix]]
* '''Published:''' 6 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed HB Kavanix LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

This deck is amazing.  It is very easy to win with, and works very well.  I have yet to have a deck compete with it.  14-0.

The published list has 68 cards.

== Strategy ==

This deck is pretty simple.  First turn deploy aquaris with Calrissian and the falcon to Hidden Base, Hopefully you'll have enough force to get there, if not, deploy endor instead.  Activate a bit.  Never play ballzy with this deck.  Stay away from the opponent during this game.  Whent they drop a few guys to any sit, place an undercover spy there.  Hook anyhting that is abuseive, i.e Trample, Force Lightning, etc. Stay in space at all times, drain and battle only in space.  Hold the Houjx until the Lateral Damage comes out.  Use the X wing laser cannons wisely.  Spread out, and use Hyper Escape.  Try to pull off Legendary Starfighter.  The biggest thing in the deck is the spies, so don't lose 'em early, and don't throw them away in space.  Remember, you can cancel Visage by dropping a spy in the Holotheater, and then Put an Undercover in him.  All the spies are pilots, and Insurrection adds two to the forfeit of all of the rebels of ability less than 3.
